Chapter 6265: Be Good Now

Chapter 6265: Be Good Now

"Boom!" The tribulation flames enjoyed freedom after the tree's collapse and devoured the sky.

"Ahh!" They swallowed the three descending emperors and reduced them to ashes. Next was the arched portal.

The primal ancestor beyond the portal became afraid and immediately closed it. Despite the fast reaction, this ancestor still lost one hand and bellowed in pain.

The crowd became shocked because cultivation didn't matter. The tribulation flames loomed above them all.

Just like that, five emperors were killed and one primal ancestor suffered injuries. However, the flames didn't stop and engulfed Li Qiye, burning everything beneath the crater.

"Young Noble!" Li Xian and the others shouted in horror.

Bronze-blade and Coldblade could only watch. They only had one dao fruit so if they were to try to save him, they would only be needlessly throwing their lives away.

"Wait, what happened..." Princess Chen said in a daze.

"It's okay, just a little flame." Black Witch Monarch was the only calm one and patted her shoulder.

***

Meanwhile, Li Qiye smiled during the free fall accompanied by tribulation flames. Eventually, a green light greeted him - the life force of Bodhi Ancestor empowered by worldly energy.

He took it to his mind and roared within his consciousness: "Accept!"

His supreme laws initiated a fusion which the green light didn't refuse. At the same time, he also took in the tribulation flames regardless of their intent.

An abundant life force came first before the devastating tribulation flames. Supreme overlords couldn't have endured this process.

Nevertheless, Li Qiye was the lord of his mind, even above the high heaven. Thus, the two power streams couldn't do anything to him.

He sealed the green life force first into a green ocean. As for the sentient flames, they felt tricked by this development. Their first reaction was not to burn his mind but to escape.

Li Qiye was amused by this attempt since he had total control of his mental domain.

"Be good now." His will was absolute. Not even the flames of a tribulation could resist since this power was born from his indomitable dao heart.

"Bam!" The flames were immediately immobilized, being refined into gentle streams of fiery liquid.

Next, he raised his hand and refined the green life force as well. As it grew smaller, it shifted from blue to green, dark green, and then black. It became a boring black rock, seemingly valueless.

Next, Li Qiye sent the streams of tribulation flames around it, burning down one layer after another. Each removed layer was infused with the bottom during this refinement process, growing stronger while becoming purer.
